Stock market news | Indian States Raise ₹7 Trillion via Borrowings in FY27

Indian states raised ₹7 trillion through market borrowings so far in FY27. However, the total amount raised remains 12% below the original plan for the financial year.

Three states - Uttar Pradesh, West Bengal, and Karnataka - accounted for nearly 62% of the increase in state borrowings. Meanwhile, the Centre trimmed its own FY27 borrowing programme.
